title: Lithuania moves SkyFortress from Ukrainian test-system adoption into planned deployment before detection performance is known
source_unit: Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence account of SkyFortress test-system deployment
geography: Lithuania; national airspace-surveillance and counter-drone system

deployment_stage.value: Lithuania will install Ukraine's test SkyFortress airspace-surveillance system

detection_route.value: acoustic and radio-frequency signatures used to classify low-flying objects in real time

ai_function.value: AI-assisted detection and tracking of low-flying drones or cruise missiles described by the ministry

contract_support.value: sensor-data processing, non-classified acoustic and radio-frequency signature libraries, and personnel training included

test_objective.value: testing will determine the system's capacity to detect and identify low-flying UAVs in Lithuania

validated_performance_and_effect.unit: missing installation completion, coverage, detection rate, false positives, identification accuracy, uptime, interoperability, training completion, warning, interception, civilian protection, deterrence, and public legitimacy

mechanism.value: A named test deployment creates a possible surveillance input into the air-defence chain, but planned installation and testing are not validated detection or demonstrated protection.

observations.method: Structured extraction from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence announcement. Deployment, technical route, contract support, test objective, and unmeasured performance and downstream effects are coded as separate stages.
observations.uncertainty: The announcement does not provide installation date, sensor count, sites, coverage, detection or false-positive rates, identification accuracy, uptime, integration, training completion, response use, civilian protection, deterrence, or public judgment.
observations.subgroup: Lithuanian defense and airspace institutions, Ukrainian technology partners, personnel assigned to the system, allied air-defence operators, and civilians within potential coverage; no affected-person denominator is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: A test system may improve surveillance learning and use Ukrainian battlefield experience, while false positives, limited coverage, integration costs, and unvalidated performance can leave protection and public confidence unresolved.

boundary: This record establishes a reported plan to install and test a named Ukrainian SkyFortress airspace-surveillance system in Lithuania. It does not establish installation completion, validated performance, operational integration, warning or interception, civilian protection, deterrence, or public legitimacy.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the compact project follow-up memo derived from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence source; system telemetry, test logs, training records, and operational incident data are not retained.
